breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still uses the thin-walled closed tube shear-flow approximation (computing mean radius, enclosed area Am, shear flow q = T/(2Am), and τmax ≈ q/t) for the shear stress calculation. The ground truth requires using only the exact thick-walled torsion relation τmax = T·(do/2)/J with J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32. The agent repeated the original error rather than correcting it to match the ground truth.
